shadows.name: press

shadows.name: answer-hover

shadows.name: stage-answer-edge

shadows.name: account-menu

shadows.name: landing-demo
shadows.purpose: Public landing only: white playable demo above the solid blue stage.

shadows.name: landing-source-paper
shadows.purpose: Public landing only: the source-document example.

shadows.name: landing-answer-edge
shadows.purpose: Public landing only: tactile demo answer controls.

shadows.name: landing-action-pressed
shadows.purpose: Public landing only: residual edge after the local 3px press.

shadows.name: educational-game-control-edge
shadows.purpose: Educational-game directional and Drop controls: local tactile bottom edge, paired with the three-pixel active press.

shadows.name: teacher-home-create
shadows.purpose: Owned library creation links only; lists, creation forms and discovery cards remain flat with neutral borders.

motion.name: t-select
motion.purpose: Shared press and selection changes.

motion.name: t-state
motion.purpose: Shared background, border, and text-state changes.

motion.name: t-panel
motion.purpose: Shared dialog fade and entrance.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared state-transition easing.

motion.name: distribution-grow
motion.purpose: Live session distribution bar appearance.

motion.name: distribution-stagger
motion.purpose: Step between live distribution bars in SessionPage.

motion.name: landing-stage-arrival
motion.purpose: Public landing only: one entrance from translateY(16px) rotate(1deg); suppressed under reduced motion.

motion.name: landing-feedback-arrival
motion.purpose: Public landing only: feedback enters from translateY(6px); suppressed under reduced motion.

motion.name: landing-action-state
motion.purpose: Public landing only: action transform, shadow and background changes; local active travel is 3px.

motion.name: landing-workflow-state
motion.purpose: Public landing only: workflow step background and border changes.

motion.name: activity-scene-load
motion.purpose: Activity worlds only: opacity fade after the selected scene image loads; disabled when stage motion is off.

motion.name: activity-scene-camera
motion.purpose: Activity worlds only: slight scale and translation; paused during live question_open and suppressed for editing, hidden/offscreen stages, paused preference and reduced motion.

motion.name: activity-question-arrival
motion.purpose: Activity worlds only: short perspective arrival on the marked question surface. Preview repeats on world or phase change; live questions repeat on question identity.

motion.name: activity-atmosphere
motion.purpose: Activity worlds only: twelve decorative theme-specific particles using transform and opacity. No particles in Classic or after a failed scene image.

motion.name: activity-preview-answer
motion.purpose: Activity picker only: transform state; a 3px downward press with -2deg rotation.

motion.name: activity-preview-podium
motion.purpose: Activity picker only: podium rise, with 0/120/60ms delays in display order.

motion.name: activity-live-podium
motion.purpose: Live activity podium: existing JavaScript vertical entrance and finite confetti gated by the shared motion preference/reduced motion; preference-off cancels the animation and resets confetti. Stage hidden/offscreen suppression covers CSS, not this separate effect.

motion.name: activity-gallery-hover
motion.purpose: Activity picker only: image scale to 1.025 on gallery hover; disabled by device reduced motion.

motion.name: educational-game-control-press
motion.purpose: Educational-game controls move down 3px while pressed. Device reduced motion removes the transition and travel; this does not describe renderer timing or frame-rate performance.

motion.name: student-action-state
motion.purpose: Student blue/yellow actions move down 2px; reduced motion removes transitions and travel.

motion.name: teacher-home-create-hover
motion.purpose: Owned library creation links lift 1px and change background on hover; reduced motion removes the transition and travel.

Let’s talk

Have a question about your account, need help with an activity, or want to use Asasera with your team? Send us a message.

10–5,000 characters. Keep passwords and payment details out of your message.

To the Asasera team at support@asasera.com

narrative.northStar: Familiar quiz authoring and a theatrical classroom
narrative.overview:
On 8 September 2026 the user restored the main brand color to Asasera Blue `#004CCC`, replacing `#46178F` throughout the application. All of those live uses now resolve through `--color-brand-500`. Earlier purple classroom descriptions and review captures below document the previous color; this explicit color update takes precedence. The existing layout, answer colors, other theme variants and type system continue to apply.

Asasera uses the user's Kahoot reference as its visual authority. Authoring is a compact working environment: white controls and rails, gray canvas, a centered question, and colored answer inputs. Classroom delivery expands that same vocabulary into a purple stage with large white question and PIN panels. The four answer colors remain recognizable across authoring, preview, classroom play, and homework.

Arabic leads the content and direction model; Latin uses Montserrat alongside the locally hosted Arabic face. Clear wording, shape, selection outlines, and a separate feedback row carry information alongside color. The interface supports the sequence of authoring, approval, delivery, play, and evidence without making each step a new visual identity.

The public landing extends the existing quiz world with a solid Asasera-blue stage, yellow creation action, emphatic bilingual headings, and a playable four-color demonstration. The user's pinned playful Kahoot direction and current Asasera primary remain its authority. keyCharacteristics: Asasera Blue Classic or a selected scenic activity world, with a quiet creator canvas.
Fixed red triangle, blue diamond, yellow circle, and green square answer identities.
Compact rectangular controls, softly rounded containers, and tactile answer presses.
Large classroom type, wrapping answer text, and feedback in its own row.
Mirrored interface chrome with stable image geometry and numeric identifiers.

rules.name: The Paired Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep each answer slot's color and shape together: red triangle, blue diamond, yellow circle, green square. Use text and a mark to report correctness.

rules.name: The Foreground Rule
rules.body: Use white on red and blue answers and dark ink on yellow answers. White on the shared green answer tile requires a bold label of at least 20px; preserve the inherited classroom size when it is larger.

rules.name: The Landing Color Roles Rule
rules.body: On the public landing, reserve Play Yellow for creation and emphasis; keep the answer-slot yellow and its circle identity unchanged.

rules.name: The Stable Game Plane Rule
rules.body: Change the environment around the question, while retaining solid reading surfaces, the four paired answer identities, written feedback and deliberate progression.

rules.name: The Inherited Answer Size Rule
rules.body: An answer label inherits its tile's size. The green minimum may enlarge a small label, but it must never reduce a classroom label to the minimum.

rules.name: The Separate Feedback Rule
rules.body: Answer glyph and wording share the main row. Correctness text and trailing feedback wrap into a contained row beneath them at the small-label size.

rules.name: The Stable Geometry Rule
rules.body: Mirror interface chrome through logical start/end properties. Keep image regions and their coordinates in the same physical image frame; numeric PINs and coordinates retain left-to-right presentation.

rules.name: The Pressed Key Rule
rules.body: Primary actions and shared answer tiles move down by 4px on press as their inset edge disappears; avoid an unrelated lift or bounce for that same state.

rules.name: The Resting Challenge Rule
rules.body: Keep authoring still, settle question arrival quickly, pause the scenic camera during open live questions, and let the motion preference or reduced-motion setting suppress travel without hiding learning state.

rules.name: The Four Shapes Rule
rules.body: Draw the answer symbols as SVG geometry and keep their identities stable as they scale. They are answer markers, not general-purpose decorations.

rules.name: The Demonstration Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the public landing's sample quiz and workflow previews visibly identified, and retain written feedback alongside their color and shape states.

rules.name: The Physical Game Controls Rule
rules.body: Mirror bilingual interface wording while retaining left-to-right physical controls and board coordinates, so Left and Right continue to describe movement in the arena.

rules.name: The Learning and Play Rule
rules.body: Keep reviewed answer feedback, game points and academic correctness distinct; present game resources as the bridge from a question to an actively controlled round.

rules.name: The Optional Wheel Rule
rules.body: Keep selection separate from assessment, preserve the selected result across reconnect, and let the teacher decide when to open, spin, reset and close the wheel. Full names remain readable outside the rotating graphic.

rules.name: Shared Dropdown Rule
rules.body: Use the shared Select component for choices. Keep API IDs and labels, allow search for long lists, and pair blue selected fill with a checkmark. Menus use scoped 8px trigger, 12px popup and 7px row radii, 48px triggers, dark/Arabic support and reduced motion. Account and session action menus share the same dropdown palette. See DESIGN.md Shared dropdowns; current rendered verification remains outstanding.
